[Story]
Sister Zhang is always the cooking master at home, but she catches a cold recently, and everything she eats has no taste. Today is a family gathering, her husband takes a bite of the food Sister Zhang makes and directly says, "Do you rob the salt seller?"

[Question]
Why does Sister Zhang's husband say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He thinks Sister Zhang is the salt seller.
B. He thinks the food is too salty, using the salt seller as a metaphor.
C. He thinks Sister Zhang robs the salt seller.
D. He thinks the food Sister Zhang makes has no taste.
